Hackney specialized in the history of the American South since the Civil War. Beveridge Award of the [American Historical Association](/wiki/American_Historical_Association "American Historical Association"). Coordination among oil-producing states within OPEC made it easier for them to nationalize oil production and structure oil prices in their favor without incurring punishment by Western governments and firms.[[10]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEColgan2021The_Rise_of_OPEC,_pp._59–93-10)
